name: Partial Cubes Are Strictly Bipartite
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every finite partial cube is bipartite, and the containment is strict.
proof: The Djoković–Winkler characterization includes bipartiteness. The graph $K_{2,3}$ is bipartite but its Djoković–Winkler relation is not transitive, so it is not a partial cube.
